body:
CI-NP bounded recognition clarification — root review accepted for independent test preparation only.

Root read the complete architect proposal49bee3107622723e84e4bfb24ec6f36341d41bb9f9821f5086dd006c7cdde213 and grammar amendmenta00c2aa948704e1c741d6f6a06b4654c55e9a8b1f3af3ea9b37935c6dc160a15 against current carriers.py and unchanged accepted acceptance/design/interface. The demonstrated subject is a classifier falsely treating ordinary progress/JS/quote-led UTF-8/Basic prose as a declared encoding. Actual project diagnostic15df847be96dec1241fb2086143cc05bcef9fb32f626b5c88b0577158738a6fa contains4lawful and4refused twins; it is not a real product runtime result.

Accepted finite clarification: implicit JSON requires a complete syntactic span followed by the existing strict original-byte decoder; an object-key introducer still positively declares JSON and malformed introduced objects refuse. Parse and scan the complete original text and every remainder; complete embedded strings must not hide suffixes. Decoded supported carriers use the same type recognition with unchanged cumulative accounting. Ordinary Basic prose is distinct from an explicit authorization declaration; canonical credential-shaped tokens remain inspected. Four explicit source classes (normalized scalar auth fields, Postman key/name-value, typed basic descendants, explicit raw authorization headers) retain strict complete-token grammar, canonical codec/UTF-8/colon validation and refusal after declared parse failure. Protected fields preserve findings even when later traversal refuses. No pathname/archive-specific exceptions or blanket catch-and-ignore.

All existing holder expectations, duplicate plain/escaped-key refusals, noncanonical supported encoding, explicit malformed carrier rules, output projection/privacy and safe diagnostics remain binding. Default and upper ceilings, equality boundaries, decoded-node/depth semantics, and the two padded-binary plus six true node-limit historical refusals are unchanged. No retention result is relabelled and no deletion is authorized.

Independent tester /root/e2e_audit may now freeze a separate narrow scan/project/check holder for these lawful/protected/malformed/budget/diagnostic classes, using genuine unchanged prerequisites and the existing immutable regression suite. Future source author is /root/release_supply_arch; source mutation remains forbidden until the new holder is independently reviewed/replayed and a bounded root source transition is published. Root review SHA2567b5aaec98be58ce9b051fd5287e5ed677aaf1c3d71a5a35520ab5a403094504c. Consumer pins/runtime/main/closure remain pending; #1810 stays OPEN.
